# The app's window over MCP

The raea app's window (raea-page-host, `raea-window` inside raea.app) can serve an MCP server on
`http://127.0.0.1:PORT/mcp`: Streamable HTTP, JSON answers. It is how an agent drives the app as a person would and sees
what they see: real input events, the interface's elements with their `data-testid`s, the window as a PNG, and any Bevy
Remote Protocol method. Access: HOST. The packaged app serves it only when started with RAEA_PAGE_MCP_PORT set
(tools/raea-app/launch.sh; RAEA_APP_HEADLESS=1 runs it with no window, as its own checks do); a page host started by
hand serves 7477 unless RAEA_PAGE_MCP_PORT says otherwise (0: none). The conformance suite (sdk/ui/conformance) drives
the app through `input` and `ui`.

## input

One input event in window points, posted as the window gets it (the messages winit writes, picking and focus see them as real): move {x,y}; down/up {x,y,button,clicks}; leave; wheel {x,y,dy,dx?,unit: pixel|line,phase?}; key {key, mods, state?: down|up} (no state: down then up); text {text}; ime {marked?, commit?}; resize {w,h}. Returns {frame}: the frame it landed before (the first frame that saw it).

## ui

The interface as presented in the latest frame: {frame, window: {w,h}, nodes: [{id, role, name, rect: {x,y,w,h} (window points), visible, hovered, focused, pressed, selected, value, scroll?: {top, max}, text?}]}, one per element with a data-testid.

## frame_png

The composited window as a PNG (the render target read back from the GPU).

## state

The app's state: frame, window, scale, and what the app adds.

## actions

The page's actions, as it names them (its emit("actions", ...)): [{name, about, args}].

## action

Runs one of the page's actions as a click there would: {name, args?}. Returns what it returned.

## brp

Any Bevy Remote Protocol method on the running app, by name: Bevy's own (world.query, world.get_components, world.insert_components, world.mutate_components, world.get_resources, world.write_message, world.trigger_event, registry.schema, schedule.list, schedule.graph, ...), the host's (page.*) and any plugin's. A +watch method answers with its first result. See brp_methods.

## brp_methods

The Bevy Remote Protocol methods this app answers (rpc.discover): [name].
